decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. TXN-007993 posted on 2026-08-07, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-27, which is 81 days later. The limit is 120 days. The posted amount is 11736 minor units (117.36 EUR). This equals the authorised amount of 11736 on AUTH-008193, which was approved for an e-commerce payment with 3-D Secure authenticated and the CVV matched. The cardholder says the quote was 75.12 EUR, which would make the difference 4224 minor units. However, the cardholder has no quote and no documents are attached. A stated amount is a claim, not a receipt. With no receipt and the posted amount equal to the authorised amount, nothing in the records shows a different agreed amount. The policy for this situation (amount-no-receipt) is to request the receipt or order details from the merchant.

proposed_actions.note: Please provide the receipt, quote or order details for the 117.36 EUR transaction made on 2026-08-06, showing the amount the cardholder agreed to pay.
